name: ContactSheetGallery
job: Show a photo set as a printed contact sheet; picking a frame circles it in grease pencil and lifts it into a large view
visitor_action: click/tap a frame; arrow keys move between frames; Esc closes the large view; swipe between photos in the large view
mobile: 3-column sheet, tap opens full-width view, swipe between photos
motion: marker circle draws itself, picked frame lifts with spring and soft shadow (reduced-motion: static circle, instant open)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: ring dash rendering + overlay fitted to visible area)
checks.craft: pass (1 polish pass: heading width, title size, header spacing)

art_direction: Darkroom proof: warm off-white photo paper, carbon-black film borders with tiny edge numbers, china-marker red circle, fine paper grain
